# Entries of kind 10 (certify), 11 (admit) and 12 (revoke), format version 1
# (crates/identity/src/format.rs). One line per vector: kind | entry | id.
# Each is the second entry of the device with the seed 00 01 02 … 1f, after
# its announce entry. The fields are fixed bytes, not a real team: team 01…,
# under 02…, one parent (03…, 4, 05…), member 06…, role admin, cut 7, key
# 08…, one lockbox (08…, 06…, aabbcc). The chain is the one of
# certificate-v1.txt; it is not this device's, which the format does not check.
# Computed outside this crate (Python: hashlib, cryptography).
